title: How do I move a Savings & Money Market Accounts account up to the highest money market tier the owner qualifies for?
content:
## Situation and policy

This policy applies when the owner of a Savings & Money Market Accounts account asks to move the account up to the highest-ranked money market tier they qualify for.

- **Active status.** The account must be active when the conversion is recorded, so a dormant account is converted only after the owner has made a customer-initiated transaction in the same contact and the account has been reactivated. A dormant account has been reactivated through a customer-initiated transaction in the same contact before any conversion is recorded. Where that has not happened, no conversion is recorded.
- **What the conversion does.** It changes only the account's tier, charges no fee, ends any promotional period on the conversion date and does not restart the early closure window.

## Business effect

One call changes only the account's tier to the named tier, effective the current date. The account keeps its number, balance and history, and the account lookup then shows the new tier name.

## How it is invoked

The tool is convert_savings_tier_d500151b. It is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call) by the agent.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format or allowed values |
|---|---|---|
| savings_account_id | the reference number of the account being converted, as returned by the savings account lookup | identifier |
| variant_name | the official name of the tier the account converts into | exactly one of: Starter Savings (the entry savings tier), Statement Savings (the standard statement savings tier), Goal Builder Savings (the goal-based savings tier), Money Market Account (the standard money market tier), Premier Money Market (the higher-balance money market tier), Private Client Money Market (the money market tier reserved for Private Client Checking customers) |

The tool records the tier it is given; it does not choose the tier or check eligibility.

## Return

A successful call returns savings_account_id (the account converted), previous_tier (the tier before the call) and new_tier (the tier after the call). A new_tier equal to the requested tier means the conversion was recorded.

## Contract Q&A

**Does the call move money or charge anything?** No; it changes only the tier.

**How is it confirmed that the conversion was recorded?** The receipt's new_tier equals the tier that was requested.

**Illustrative call (hypothetical):** savings_account_id of the account and variant_name Premier Money Market; the receipt shows the earlier tier as previous_tier and Premier Money Market as new_tier.
